_comment: Reads the filled 2x2 down the columns: compare shares, not counts, because the groups differ in size.

stem.en: Illustrative case. Of the 20 patients, 14 had cleaned the reactors; of the 60 controls, 9 had. By how many percentage points do the two shares differ? Give your answer to 1 decimal place.

explanation.en: 14 / 20 = 70.0 per cent and 9 / 60 = 15.0 per cent, so the shares differ by 55.0 percentage points. The shares are compared rather than the counts because the two groups are different sizes.

hints.en: Work out each share with its own group total, then subtract one share from the other.
